mods.name: QoL Bundle

## English

- New module: **Redstone Timing** (key I). Arm it over an area (Litematica's selection, or the blocks around you), start your machine, and every block that changed shows its place in the order, the game tick it first changed and the tick it came to rest. In singleplayer the numbers are exact: the game itself runs the machine and every change is recorded in its real order, then the area is put back. On a server the changes are timed as they arrive (marked ≈).
- New module: **Flow Meter**. Bind chests, barrels, hoppers... with a key; a screen shows items in and out per container and in total, with rates per hour (singleplayer: read from the world; on a server: asked like F3 + I for operators, else updated while the container is open).

## 中文

- 新模块：**红石时序**（I 键）。在一个区域上准备好（Litematica 选区，或者你周围的方块），启动机器，每个动过的方块都会显示它是第几个动的、第几 gt 开始动、第几 gt 停下。单人里完全准确：机器是游戏自己跑的，每一个变化都按真实顺序记下来，跑完把区域恢复原样。在服务器上按收到变化的时间算（标 ≈）。
- 新模块：**流量计**。用快捷键绑定箱子、木桶、漏斗等，在单独的界面看每个容器和合计的进出数量、每小时多少（单人直接读世界；服务器上管理员像 F3 + I 一样要数据，不然在打开容器时更新）。

## English

- New module: **Container Presets**. Arrange a container, click "Save current", and later fill any container of the same kind the same way with one click (handy for hopper item-filter slices).
- Presets are kept on your computer, separately for each kind of container. Items are matched exactly, so a renamed item never stands in for a plain one.
- By default nothing is placed if the container holds anything that differs from the preset, or if materials are short. Both checks can be turned off in the settings.
- HUD text size: one setting for all text in the screen corners (**HUD text & layout**, at the top of the settings), and every HUD module can have its own. Auto matches MiniHUD's text size when MiniHUD is installed, so lines like the respawn point are no longer twice the size of MiniHUD's.
- QoL Bundle's corner lines no longer overlap MiniHUD's info lines, in any corner, and stay clear of the effect icons and the hotbar. Space for other HUD mods can be kept free by hand.

## 中文

- 新增模块：**容器摆放预设**。把容器摆好后点“保存当前”，以后同种容器点一下就按预设放好（做漏斗过滤单片很方便）。
- 预设存在你自己电脑上，按容器种类分开。物品按完整信息比对，改过名的物品不会被当成普通物品。
- 默认只要容器里有和预设不一样的东西，或者材料不够，就什么都不放。这两项检查都能在设置里关掉。
